🚀 Hiring: Product Security Architect |
📍 Location: Remote – USA 
⏳ Duration: Long-Term Contract

Mandatory Requirements:
12+ years of experience in #Product #Security, #Embedded #Security, or #IoT Security #Architecture.
Strong expertise in #ARM TrustZone, Secure Boot, #Hardware Root of Trust, and cryptographic key management.
Hands-on experience with secure #OTA firmware updates, PKI, TLS/mTLS, and #hardware security modules (HSM/TPM/Secure Elements).
Proven experience with #EU Cyber Resilience Act (#CRA) and/or RED Delegated Act compliance.
Strong C/C++ programming skills for embedded systems (#ARM Cortex-A/Cortex-M/8051).
Experience in product vulnerability management (PSIRT), penetration testing, and threat modeling.
Knowledge of IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, and firmware security hardening.

📩 Interested candidates: Please share your updated resume via DM or sanni.kumar@exlneo.com



#Hiring #ProductSecurity #EmbeddedSecurity #IoTSecurity #CyberSecurity #HappiestMinds #ContractJobs #Remote #USA
